paragraphs: Exulu IMP (Intelligence Management Platform) is an open-source TypeScript framework for building production-ready AI agent applications. It provides the backend infrastructure for managing agents, semantic search contexts, background job processing, and tool integrations.
features: 🤖 Multi-provider agents - Built-in support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Cerebras and any AI SDK provider
🔍 Semantic search - Vector-powered RAG with pgvector and automatic embedding generation
⚙️ Background workers - BullMQ-based job queues for long-running tasks
🔐 Authentication - API keys, NextAuth integration, and role-based access control
🛠️ Tool system - Extend agent capabilities with custom functions and external APIs
